subject: Finexa — request to prioritize on-demand inference snapshotting for audit
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Finexa — request to prioritize on-demand inference snapshotting for audit

Evelyn / Karthik —

Quick summary: Finexa (prospect, large financial services account) surfaced a hard compliance requirement during procurement: they need the ability to create tamper-evident, on-demand "inference snapshots" that capture the full request/response (inputs, outputs, model id/version, effective sampling parameters, token-level timestamps or offsets if possible), package as an exportable archive, and store to their S3 with KMS-managed encryption. This is a gating item for contract signature.

Why this matters: Finexa is a 10M ARR ACV opportunity and their procurement team insists on an auditable replay artifact for regulated audits. CS estimates this is non-negotiable for the initial roll; they will not sign until they can demonstrate reproducible inference records.

Asks:
- Can Product/Eng evaluate prioritizing a minimal viable feature to satisfy procurement: an API call (POST /v1/inference/snapshots) that creates a snapshot for a given session/request id and returns a signed archive location.
- Snapshot MVP should include model id/version, prompt, full response, cost breakdown, and a checksum/signature.
- Export to customer S3 + support retention policy + KMS.
- Target: able to deliver an MVP in a single sprint spike + one follow-up sprint to harden (customer expecting timeline before next week pricing approval).

Attachments: finexa_audit_req.pdf (procurement note), initial_data_schema.csv

Next steps I need from you: quick feasibility (yes/no), estimated timeline (spike + dev), and any blocker (security/infra/legal). We may be able to offer a 3-month credit commitment in exchange for fast-tracked work — Marissa can comment on commercial levers.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter

Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finexa — request to prioritize on-demand inference snapshotting for audit

Thanks Ben — useful context and the attachment helped. Looping in product and security questions upfront.

High-level response: conceptually reasonable; this maps to our existing audit/export capabilities but requires a narrow, well-scoped extension to be deliverable quickly. I propose the following path:

1) Spike (1 week): product + eng + security to define PRD for snapshot schema, signing approach, S3 export flow, and threat model (tamper evidence vs. access control).
2) Development (2 sprints): build the API endpoint + export; limit initial rollout to Dedicated/Hosted with a feature flag for Finexa.
3) Harden (1 sprint): retention controls, KMS integration testing, and small audit report generator.

Questions we need answered from Sales/CS to scope the spike:
- What exact retention windows do they require? (30/90/365 days)
- Do they require token-level timing or is a per-response event timestamp sufficient?
- Will Finexa accept a PII redaction/field-level filtering as part of the snapshot?

Commercial ask: if they need the full hardened product in <4 weeks we need a funded redirect (Marissa — can you confirm willingness to trade credits/advance on SOW?).

I can staff a small product lead and dev PM for the spike — Karthik, can you allocate a senior engineer for the 1-week spike?

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
VP, Product — Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finexa — request to prioritize on-demand inference snapshotting for audit

Ben / Evelyn —

Thanks for the clear ask. Engineering thoughts and constraints:

- Feasibility: doable as an opt-in feature. We can implement a lightweight snapshot API that records the request/response + metadata and emits a signed archive to customer S3.
- Key engineering work: serialization schema, signing (we prefer HMAC with key rotation or envelope signing via KMS), export worker (reliability at scale), and retention lifecycle scheduler.
- Risk: storing full request/response increases storage and egress costs; for large outputs we need chunking and stream-to-s3 to avoid memory pressure.
- Security: will require security review for the exact signing model. If Finexa requires non-repudiation with our managed signing keys, Legal needs to approve. Alternatively, we can KMS-encrypt the archive using the customer's key to avoid holding plaintext.

Proposed near-term plan:
1) Schedule a 1-week spike (engineer + product) to produce a PRD + prototype that writes to a sandbox S3 and demonstrates signed archives.
2) If prototype is OK, allocate 2 sprints (P1) to implement MVP behind a feature flag.

I can assign Priya (senior infra eng) for the spike starting Mon, Apr 5. Priya will need access to the Finexa procurement doc and a sample request/response log to replicate their expected payload size. Ben / Marissa: can you share the logs or a representative export?

I'll add this to the Eng backlog for DEAL-8421 and label as P1 pending commercial commitment.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Engineering — Serving Runtime
